llm_summary: Summary: User sentiment regarding Kiehl's Ultra Facial Oil-Free Gel Cream is mixed, with many valuing its lightweight, non-greasy texture that avoids causing breakouts. While it is frequently praised as an effective, shine-free moisturizer for those with oily or acne-prone skin, some users report that it lacks sufficient hydration for deeper moisture needs. Overall, it is often utilized as a reliable daily staple, though it may not be robust enough for individuals managing drier skin or stronger treatment-based routines.
